rule: SQL comes back bare, no prose or semicolons
DuckDB has no initcap; title case is spelled out
a computed column keeps every other column
a rename keeps every other column
rows are kept unless the user asks to filter
phrase: Always preserve all rows unless the user explicitly asks to filter

rule: an ambiguous request asks a question in JSON
a question about values is answered with a query, not a step
a query aggregates to a few rows
a query leaves empty values out of groups and rankings
an insight never guesses a value
phrase: Never guess a value, a total or a top item in an insight

rule: when in doubt it is a question, not a change
a lookup is a LEFT JOIN with one match per key
a lookup keeps every row of data
strict mode says the values were never seen
phrase: You have not seen any values
